summary: Fair page + parkwith.us engine: 69 full-hookup 30/50 sites; 18 sold nightly at $55 + fees/tax (max 29 nights), 57 monthly ($1,150, 31-night min), overflow event-only; season 04-15..11-01; shower house. Fairgrounds test passes (nightly sites bookable all season, no event restriction). Long-stay share high (~76% monthly) - flagged. Pin ok.
flags: FAIRGROUNDS TEST: passes. The fair's own campground page sells 'Daily Rate — $55.00 per night' and its booking engine (parkwith.us, linked from 'Book Now') sells a 'Short Term Site' class of 18 sites by the night through a 04-15..11-01 season with no event restriction, minimum_bookable_nights null; a separate 'Overflow Sites' class (not bookable online, 1-3 nights) is the event overflow. Ordinary nights outside events are rented.

LONG-STAY SHARE: only 18 of 75 listed RV sites are nightly (24%); 57 are 'long-term-site' with a 31-night minimum and a monthly rate, and imagery (spring) shows most rows occupied. The nightly class is a distinct, permanently-assigned block (sites 1-15 and 48-50), so nightly guests are not squeezed out, but it is a mostly-monthly park. No wording discourages nightly guests. Google: no separate panel for the campground; 'Red River Valley Fair Association' 4.3 from 1,087 (the fairgrounds). AWH to judge against the five long-stay tests; I lean keep (ownership local/fair association, nightly class real and bookable).

PRICE: $55 + 5.5% tax + 6% booking service fee (~$61 total). Over $50, but the gate applies to private parks only and this is stored local (fair association); flag for AWH if the fair association should count as private. Gateway check not run.

SITES: engine lengths: short-term back-ins 48 ft, pull-throughs 100 ft (100 looks like a placeholder); long-term back-ins 30-55 ft. Stored max_rig_ft 50 left alone; a 23-ft rig fits every nightly site.
SEASON: stored year_round true (derived) contradicted by the engine's 04-15..11-01 season; replaced.
